Ai Electronics ABC 24
====
## CP/M; 158kB 35-track DSDD
<!-- This file is automatically generated. Do not edit. -->

Ai Electronics was a Japanese computer company that produced minicomputers during the 1960s and 1970s. In 1979 they
started production of the ABC, the Ai Business Computer, a decently specced CP/M machine with 64kB RAM, a Z80, twin
floppy drives, GBIP ports, and a maths coprocessor.

The floppy disks it uses are relatively normal 35-track IBM scheme disks, with cylinder 0 reserved as the boot track.

## Options

(no options)

## Examples

To read:

  - `fluxengine read -c abc -s drive:0 -o abc.img`

To write:

  - `fluxengine write -c abc -d drive:0 -i abc.img`
